digest.component_or_area: code review criteria routing and gate posture
propositions: correctness and edge-cases are base-reviewer dimensions absent from criteria_routing.json that default to non-blocking 0.95 threshold and must be explicitly routed
measurement of correctness and edge-cases at 0.54 threshold over 1262 code-v3 changes shows 4.04% and 1.74% impact respectively, both within the 8.0% operator-accepted friction budget
routing entries for correctness and edge-cases must be added to criteria_routing.json with block_threshold 0.54 and blocking_enabled true to enable blocking on these dimensions
replay_code_v4_would_block.py hard-codes its blocking set and must derive it from routing_index() to prevent drift from actual posture
adding correctness and edge-cases to routing widens the canonical vocabulary via registry.effective_criteria() and must be asserted in tests
